text:
amar: Quick follow-up from the INC-345 postmortem: recurring cache evictions are still the main signal. We need concrete runbook edits, a canary plan, and clear SLAs for verification. 10m sync?
sasha: No meeting unless folks want one. Let's capture owners here. I can own the playbook wording and escalation paragraphs.
maya: I'll take the runbook PR (include config diff + test steps). Plan to add a "when to patch" section and the exact diagnostic commands we used.
liam: I'll do the rollout and monitoring checklist. Proposed timeline: runbook PR in 3 business days, canary next Wednesday, full rollout after 1 week of stable metrics.
defops-bot: Created tasks INC-345-FU-A (owner: maya), INC-345-FU-B (owner: liam), INC-345-FU-C (owner: sasha). Links: https://tracker/INC-345-FU-A, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-B, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-C
sasha: Good. Maya, include the quick triage snippet and the mitigation we used. Put the TTL change in a feature-flagged config so we can roll back easily.
maya: Adding snippet now. Also adding exact commands we ran during the outage:
```
# check eviction rate by shard
curl -s "http://metrics.internal/query?expr=cache_evictions_total%7Bshard%7D" | jq .data
# list keys with shortest TTL in staging
redis-cli -h staging.cache.internal --raw keys "session:*" | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'echo -n {} && echo -n " \t" && redis-cli -h staging.cache.internal ttl {}' | sort -k2 -n | head -n 25
# show top callers filling the cache in last 5m
curl -s "http://logs.internal/search?query=cache_set+%7C+stats%28%29+%7C+top(10)%"
```
liam: Rollout notes I'll add to the checklist: deploy config to canary pool (5% traffic), watch 5m windows for evictions, p95 latency, and 4xx spikes. If any metric exceeds thresholds (evictions > 10/min OR p95 latency +30% vs baseline) -> rollback.
sasha: What are the rollback steps? Put them in the runbook as explicit commands.
maya: Rollback plan in runbook will use the feature flag and a quick revert command. Draft rollback commands:
```
# disable TTL experiment flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/api/flags/ttl_experiment -d '{"enabled":false}'
# restore config map to last good revision
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/cache-proxy --to-revision=3
```
liam: For safety I'll include a one-command revert for k8s and a cache prefix cleanup script in case the experiment applied new keys:
```
# cleanup keys added by experiment
redis-cli -h cache.primary del "experiment:ttl:*" || true
# restart cache-proxy gracefully
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/cache-proxy
```
defops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up review in 5 days for INC-345-FU-A.
sasha: Escalation change for playbook: add a "repeated evictions" path. If the same cluster sees 2 eviction incidents within 10 days, auto-escalate to oncall-sre + oncall-platform and open a recurring-review ticket. Include sample pager payload in the runbook.
maya: Adding sample pager msg and the metrics query that triggers it. I'll include dashboard links.
liam: I'll add the Grafana queries and alert thresholds to the checklist and link them from the playbook.
sasha: Recap of action items and due dates:
- INC-345-FU-A (maya): runbook PR + config diff + triage commands (due in 3 business days)
- INC-345-FU-B (liam): canary rollout + monitoring checklist (canary next Wed)
- INC-345-FU-C (sasha): playbook escalation paragraph + pager example (due EOD Fri)
defops-bot: Tickets updated with due dates and owners.
amar: Thanks. If anyone hits a blocker, reopen thread or request a 15m sync. Otherwise we'll close after the canary verification window. :white_check_mark:
